item.title: natfriedman：🚨 side project alert 🚨
item.description:
🚨 side project alert 🚨

Announcing Muse Gadgets, an open source ESP32 firmware and Linux sdk so that you can make hardware devices that work with Muse.

Grab an API token from https://t.co/Q0dE0cYnCs and point your favorite coding agent at the github repo to build your own peripherals for Muse.

item.title: natfriedman：We built a gadget of our own, too: Muse Home Link is a little usb-c powered de…
item.description:
We built a gadget of our own, too: Muse Home Link is a little usb-c powered device that allows Muse to connect to your home network to talk to smart home devices like TVs and speakers and anything else that exposes https.

We manufactured a batch of 5000 Home Links which should be ready to ship in a few weeks, and they are free for Muse subscribers while supplies last. Claim yours at https://t.co/Q0dE0cYnCs

All the code for Muse Home Link is open source too!
